transcript:
MARTIN: I-I’m sorry... Look, be honest with me right now, are you messing with me? 

DAVID: What? What’s going on, man?

MARTIN: I- I... 

DAVID: Martin... I’m going back into the east wing, okay? This is all hard enough as is, I can't do it with you freaking out.

[SFX: He walks out of the room into the ruined east wing]

DAVID: What the-? (With dread) No...

[SFX: We hear the sounds of a fire in the east wing.]

DAVID (CONT’D): How..? This isn't possible.

MARTIN (Upset): Please... Leave.

DAVID: It's on fire. It-  (Confused) There’re people there...

[SFX: We hear the fire now with sounds of some people in agony - not screaming they are too close to death - more moaning than anything.]

MARTIN: David, LEAVE.

DAVID (Suddenly terrified): ARRGHH!!

[SFX: David turns and runs... Fast. We just hear him terrified running. Behind him is an approaching force. We only hear a moan, like the voice of a man in hell, a ghoulish moan of agony and torment. It is hard to hear, but is a noise in the background catching up with him. Even as the sound of the fire disappears into the background.]


[IDLE LOOP: more of same]
